Id1.text: The Acharya Institute of Technology was established in 2000, is affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University and was given the Technical Campus status by the All India Council for Technical Education which is located in Mumbai. The Acharya Institute of Technology campus is located in Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore – 560090.
